rules: Relationship values change only through events, credible reports, observed patterns, or explicit history.
NPC knowledge and relationship state are separate; liking someone does not grant knowledge.
One dramatic action may cause a large change only when its stakes and evidence justify it.
Repeated minor interactions use diminishing returns to prevent trivial farming.
NPC choices also depend on goals, risk, law, resources, personality and current condition; relationship score is not mind control.
